Creates time values from date-time strings and from the system clock.
Every time is converted to UTC and written with nine fractional digits, so
different ways of writing the same moment produce the same document. A
string with no UTC offset, a field out of range, or more than nine
fractional digits is an error.

Also checks how a time is translated. In JSON and YAML a time is written
as a string, and reading it back gives a string, not a time. In TOML a time
is written as a date-time, and reading it back gives a time. In .strh and
.strt a time is stored like any other value.
